items.claim: Wes Schultz actively looks for and chases submissions in his fights.
items.quote: He's going to be chasing submissions

items.claim: Wes Schultz's wrestling has been non-existent and he fails to shoot takedowns effectively.
items.quote: that wrestling is non-existent. Like, he has forgotten how to shoot takedowns.

items.claim: Wes Schultz's striking is essentially non-existent.
items.quote: His striking is absolutely [ __ ] non-existent as well.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is a good scrambler on the ground.
items.quote: He's a good scrambler and stuff like that.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has shown flashes of offensive wrestling, knees, elbows, and striking.
items.quote: Knees, elbows, striking, offensive wrestling as well. You can see glimmers where he's like, 'Yeah, he could probably beat this person.'
